outcome: Concentrations of branched-chain fatty acids (BCFAs) in human milk
cohort: Healthy mothers of term singleton infants from three urban populations: Cincinnati, Ohio; Shanghai, China; and Mexico City, Mexico
finding: BCFA concentrations in human milk at 4 weeks postpartum differed between mothers from Cincinnati, Shanghai, and Mexico City, and these variations were influenced by maternal diet.
mod_finding: This study investigated the composition of breast milk and its association with maternal diet, but did not examine modes of delivery.
